title: EvilSMP
description: The datapack that was used to run the server "EvilSMP season 2". Created fully by me and the TGM team.
body:
The datapack that was used to run the server "**EvilSMP**". Created fully by me and the _TGM_ team.

Every function under _evilsmp:admin/_ is meant to be ran by a player.
**Don't run any functions under _evilsmp:datapack/_, or else you risk breaking the datapack!**
